categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the cell and gene therapy sector, offering CRO (Contract Research Organization) services including gene therapy vector development, gene function research, and drug target and efficacy studies. It also provides CDMO (Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization) services covering process development, IND-CMC pharmaceutical research, clinical sample production, and commercial GMP manufacturing. Additionally, it offers regenerative medicine services such as cell preparation, recombinant protein/exosome production, and cell storage technologies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced molecular biology platforms, virus vector packaging (including AAV, lentivirus, adenovirus), cell function research, SPF animal testing, clinical-grade gene therapy vector and cell therapy process development, quality control technologies, and cell storage platforms. It employs large-scale GMP production lines with bioreactors ranging from 5L to 2000L for plasmid fermentation and suspension cell culture. The firm integrates AI-assisted vector design, high-throughput sequencing, and deep learning for process optimization and quality control, and develops proprietary technologies in viral vector optimization, cell line development, and non-viral delivery systems like mRNA-LNP and exosomes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include research institutions, pharmaceutical companies engaged in cell and gene therapy drug development, and medical institutions. The company serves over 12,800 research laboratories and supports domestic and international clients with IND applications and clinical trial material production. Its markets span gene therapy, cell therapy, oncolytic viruses, regenerative medicine, and anti-aging sectors, focusing on early-stage research through to commercial manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Shanghai, China, with operations primarily in the domestic Chinese market including key regions such as East China (Yangtze River Delta), South China (Shenzhen), North China (Beijing), Southwest China, and other domestic regions. It also has overseas subsidiaries, including one in the United States, and is expanding its international market presence, targeting major global biopharmaceutical markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream and downstream service provider in the cell and gene therapy supply chain, offering outsourced research, development, and manufacturing services (CRO/CDMO) to upstream drug developers and research institutions. It does not engage in proprietary drug development but supports clients through the entire drug development lifecycle from laboratory research to commercial production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing core technologies in viral vector development and large-scale GMP manufacturing, expanding non-viral delivery platforms such as mRNA-LNP and exosomes, and advancing regenerative medicine applications. The company emphasizes AI integration for vector design and process optimization, strengthening intellectual property protection, and expanding global market reach. It also focuses on capacity ramp-up at its Shanghai Lingang precision medical industrial base and diversifying services to include cell storage and large-scale cell therapy production.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of highly customized CRO and CDMO services, including gene therapy vector packaging, cell therapy process development, clinical and commercial GMP manufacturing, and regenerative medicine services. The company also sells biological reagents and products. Income is recognized based on contract milestones and delivery confirmations, with CRO services recognized at point-in-time and CDMO services recognized over time according to progress.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic cell and gene therapy CRO/CDMO provider with comprehensive technology platforms and large-scale GMP capacity. It competes with both specialized CGT CDMO firms and larger small-molecule and biologics CRO/CDMO companies entering the CGT space. Its competitive advantages include extensive project experience, broad technology coverage, and integrated one-stop service capabilities from DNA to NDA. The industry is highly competitive with rapid technological evolution and market consolidation underway.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 248 million, a 21.16% increase year-over-year, with CRO business revenue growing 8.02% and CDMO business revenue growing 26.12%. Despite revenue growth, the company incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 321.8 million, reflecting increased operating costs from new facility ramp-up and industry pricing pressures. Total assets were RMB 2.28 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders at RMB 1.74 billion. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion, with R&D expenses accounting for 19.07% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a unique one-stop, full-cycle service platform for cell and gene therapy development, integrating advanced vector design, process development, and large-scale GMP manufacturing under one roof. It differentiates through its comprehensive technology platforms, AI-driven innovation, extensive project execution experience, and large, flexible production capacity. Its strong IP protection and ability to serve diverse therapy modalities including viral vectors, immune cells, stem cells, mRNA, and exosomes provide clients with efficient, high-quality, and scalable solutions, accelerating drug development and commercialization.
